# VIBE Real Estate

> VIBE Real Estate is an independent real-estate broker in Egypt. It presents residential projects from Egypt's leading developers, helps buyers compare units, prices and payment plans, and connects them with the developer. VIBE is not a developer: contracts are signed directly with the developer.

Prices are in Egyptian pounds (EGP), are indicative, and may be changed by the developer without notice.
Contact: phone / WhatsApp +201006140168. The site is available in Arabic (https://viberealestatre.com/) and English (https://viberealestatre.com/en/).

## Projects (Palm Hills Developments, West Cairo)

- [PX Compound](https://viberealestatre.com/en/px): PX is Palm Hills Developments' newest community in West Cairo, set on the highest point of Palm Hills October — which gives its homes open views across the whole area. From EGP 13,144,000, 5% down payment, up to 10 years installments, delivery 2028.
- [Palm Parks](https://viberealestatre.com/en/palm-parks): Palm Parks is a Palm Hills Developments community in West Cairo, right off the Dahshur Link, designed as a quiet low-density neighbourhood with open space between buildings. From EGP 17,807,000, 5% down payment, up to 8 years installments, delivery 2029.
- [Crown Extension](https://viberealestatre.com/en/crown-extension): Crown Extension is the extension of The Crown by Palm Hills Developments at the heart of Palm Hills October, close to the 26th of July Axis and the Cairo–Alexandria Desert Road. From EGP 30,521,000, 5% down payment, up to 8 years installments, delivery 2030.
- [Palm Hills One](https://viberealestatre.com/en/palm-hills-one): Palm Hills One is a villa community by Palm Hills Developments at The Hill in the heart of West Cairo, adjacent to Palm Hills October and minutes from the Cairo–Alexandria Desert Road. From EGP 47,549,000, 5% down payment, up to 8 years installments, delivery 2030.
- [Bamboo III](https://viberealestatre.com/en/bamboo-iii): Bamboo III is the third phase of Bamboo by Palm Hills Developments, inside Palm Hills October near Gezira Club and overlooking the 26th of July Axis. From EGP 27,457,000, 5% down payment, up to 10 years installments, delivery 2029.

## PX Compound

Page: https://viberealestatre.com/en/px (Arabic: https://viberealestatre.com/px)

PX is Palm Hills Developments' newest community in West Cairo, set on the highest point of Palm Hills October — which gives its homes open views across the whole area. The project spans around 370 feddans with a master plan by Chapman Taylor, split into residential zones of apartments and town houses, with a clubhouse, a commercial hub and walking trails inside the compound.

| Unit | Size | Price from (EGP) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Bedroom Apartment | 60 – 78 m² | 13,144,000 |
| 2 Bedroom Apartment | 113 – 140 m² | 19,809,000 |
| 3 Bedroom Apartment | 144 – 172 m² | 25,419,000 |
| Town House | 201 – 214 m² | 28,528,000 |
| Townhouse Middle | Built-up area 201 m², land area 212 m² | 32,638,000 |
| Townhouse Corner | Built-up area 211 m², land area 216 m² | 34,500,000 |
| Villa 4 | Built-up area 240 m², land area 282 m² | 37,000,000 |
| Villa 3 | Built-up area 246 m², land area 299 m² | 38,800,000 |
| Villa 1 | Built-up area 314 m², land area 420 – 470 m² | 53,000,000 |
| Villa 5 | Built-up area 428 m², land area 545 – 596 m² | On request |

**Where is PX Compound located?** PX sits at the heart of Palm Hills October, connected to West Cairo's main roads and surrounded by Palm Hills communities such as The Crown and Palm Parks. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in PX Compound?** Prices start from EGP 13,144,000. Available units: 1 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 13,144,000; 2 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 19,809,000; 3 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 25,419,000; Town House from EGP 28,528,000.

**What payment plans are available in PX Compound?** 5% down payment with installments over up to 10 years. A discount of up to 40% is available on the 6-year plan. The Palm Gardens phase: 5% down payment over up to 7.5 years.

**What unit types and sizes are available in PX Compound?** 1 Bedroom Apartment (60 – 78 m²); 2 Bedroom Apartment (113 – 140 m²); 3 Bedroom Apartment (144 – 172 m²); Town House (201 – 214 m²).

**When is PX Compound delivered?** Delivery starts in 2028, according to the developer.

**Are Palm Gardens homes finished?** Town houses in Palm Gardens are fully finished; villas are delivered Core & Shell.

**Is VIBE Real Estate the developer of PX Compound?** No. The developer is Palm Hills Developments. VIBE Real Estate is an independent broker that presents the project and helps you choose a unit; contracts are signed directly with the developer.

**Are the prices shown final?** Prices are indicative and may be changed by the developer without notice. The developer is the final reference at the time of contracting.

## Palm Parks

Page: https://viberealestatre.com/en/palm-parks (Arabic: https://viberealestatre.com/palm-parks)

Palm Parks is a Palm Hills Developments community in West Cairo, right off the Dahshur Link, designed as a quiet low-density neighbourhood with open space between buildings. The project is all apartments with practical layouts, with a clubhouse, swimming pools and a commercial area inside. Only a limited number of units is currently available.

| Unit | Size | Price from (EGP) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 Bedroom Apartment | 169 – 170 m² | 17,807,000 |
| 2 Bedroom Apartment with Garden | 132 m² | 18,202,000 |
| 3 Bedroom Apartment with Garden | 170 m² | 21,719,000 |

**Where is Palm Parks located?** Palm Parks sits right off the Dahshur Link in West Cairo, close to Media Production City and October's main shopping destinations. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in Palm Parks?** Prices start from EGP 17,807,000. Available units: 3 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 17,807,000; 2 Bedroom Apartment with Garden from EGP 18,202,000; 3 Bedroom Apartment with Garden from EGP 21,719,000.

**What payment plans are available in Palm Parks?** 5% down payment with installments over up to 8 years.

**What unit types and sizes are available in Palm Parks?** 3 Bedroom Apartment (169 – 170 m²); 2 Bedroom Apartment with Garden (132 m²); 3 Bedroom Apartment with Garden (170 m²).

**When is Palm Parks delivered?** Delivery is in 2029, according to the developer.

**Is VIBE Real Estate the developer of Palm Parks?** No. The developer is Palm Hills Developments. VIBE Real Estate is an independent broker that presents the project and helps you choose a unit; contracts are signed directly with the developer.

**Are the prices shown final?** Prices are indicative and may be changed by the developer without notice. The developer is the final reference at the time of contracting.

## Crown Extension

Page: https://viberealestatre.com/en/crown-extension (Arabic: https://viberealestatre.com/crown-extension)

Crown Extension is the extension of The Crown by Palm Hills Developments at the heart of Palm Hills October, close to the 26th of July Axis and the Cairo–Alexandria Desert Road. The phase offers spacious family homes — with a private garden or a penthouse — and a limited number of twin houses, in a low-density setting with wide green areas.

| Unit | Size | Price from (EGP) |
|---|---|---|
| Family Home with Penthouse | 223 m² | 30,521,000 |
| Family Home with Garden | 217 m² | 33,164,000 |
| Twin House | Built-up area 226 m², land area 281 m² | 38,213,000 |

**Where is Crown Extension located?** Crown Extension is at the heart of Palm Hills October, near the 26th of July Axis, the Cairo–Alexandria Desert Road and the Ring Road. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in Crown Extension?** Prices start from EGP 30,521,000. Available units: Family Home with Penthouse from EGP 30,521,000; Family Home with Garden from EGP 33,164,000; Twin House from EGP 38,213,000.

**What payment plans are available in Crown Extension?** 5% down payment with installments over up to 8 years. A discount of up to 30% is available on the 5-year plan.

**What unit types and sizes are available in Crown Extension?** Family Home with Penthouse (223 m²); Family Home with Garden (217 m²); Twin House (Built-up area 226 m², land area 281 m²).

**When is Crown Extension delivered?** Delivery is in 2030, according to the developer.

**Is VIBE Real Estate the developer of Crown Extension?** No. The developer is Palm Hills Developments. VIBE Real Estate is an independent broker that presents the project and helps you choose a unit; contracts are signed directly with the developer.

**Are the prices shown final?** Prices are indicative and may be changed by the developer without notice. The developer is the final reference at the time of contracting.

Page: https://viberealestatre.com/en/palm-hills-one (Arabic: https://viberealestatre.com/palm-hills-one)

Palm Hills One is a villa community by Palm Hills Developments at The Hill in the heart of West Cairo, adjacent to Palm Hills October and minutes from the Cairo–Alexandria Desert Road. It is villas only: town houses, twin houses and standalone villas in six different models, on plots from 350 m² up to 1,500 m².

| Unit | Size | Price from (EGP) |
|---|---|---|
| Town House | Built-up area 358 m², land area 350 m² | 47,549,000 |
| Twin House | Built-up area 340 – 358 m², land area 370 – 430 m² | 57,950,000 |
| Standalone Villa | Built-up area 195 – 673 m², land area 451 – 1,500 m² | 86,087,000 |

**Where is Palm Hills One located?** Palm Hills One is at The Hill in the heart of West Cairo, adjacent to Palm Hills October and close to all its services. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in Palm Hills One?** Prices start from EGP 47,549,000. Available units: Town House from EGP 47,549,000; Twin House from EGP 57,950,000; Standalone Villa from EGP 86,087,000.

**What payment plans are available in Palm Hills One?** 5% down payment with installments over up to 8 years.

**What unit types and sizes are available in Palm Hills One?** Town House (Built-up area 358 m², land area 350 m²); Twin House (Built-up area 340 – 358 m², land area 370 – 430 m²); Standalone Villa (Built-up area 195 – 673 m², land area 451 – 1,500 m²).

**When is Palm Hills One delivered?** Delivery is in 2030, according to the developer.

**Is VIBE Real Estate the developer of Palm Hills One?** No. The developer is Palm Hills Developments. VIBE Real Estate is an independent broker that presents the project and helps you choose a unit; contracts are signed directly with the developer.

## Bamboo III

Page: https://viberealestatre.com/en/bamboo-iii (Arabic: https://viberealestatre.com/bamboo-iii)

Bamboo III is the third phase of Bamboo by Palm Hills Developments, inside Palm Hills October near Gezira Club and overlooking the 26th of July Axis. The project covers around 56 feddans with lagoons, water features and wide green areas. Homes are family homes with a garden or penthouse plus middle and corner town houses — all fully finished.

| Unit | Size | Price from (EGP) |
|---|---|---|
| Family Home with Garden | 182 m² | 27,457,000 |
| Family Home with Penthouse | 191 – 192 m² | 28,750,000 |
| Town House Middle | Built-up area 221 m², land area 249 – 254 m² | 34,342,000 |
| Town House Corner | Built-up area 222 m², land area 249 – 254 m² | 35,303,000 |

**Where is Bamboo III located?** Bamboo III is on the 26th of July Axis in 6th of October, close to West Cairo's largest malls, universities and clubs. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in Bamboo III?** Prices start from EGP 27,457,000. Available units: Family Home with Garden from EGP 27,457,000; Family Home with Penthouse from EGP 28,750,000; Town House Middle from EGP 34,342,000; Town House Corner from EGP 35,303,000.

**What payment plans are available in Bamboo III?** 5% down payment with installments over up to 10 years.

**What unit types and sizes are available in Bamboo III?** Family Home with Garden (182 m²); Family Home with Penthouse (191 – 192 m²); Town House Middle (Built-up area 221 m², land area 249 – 254 m²); Town House Corner (Built-up area 222 m², land area 249 – 254 m²).

**When is Bamboo III delivered?** Delivery is in 2029, according to the developer.

**Are Bamboo III homes finished?** Yes, all the units shown are delivered fully finished.

**Is VIBE Real Estate the developer of Bamboo III?** No. The developer is Palm Hills Developments. VIBE Real Estate is an independent broker that presents the project and helps you choose a unit; contracts are signed directly with the developer.

**Are the prices shown final?** Prices are indicative and may be changed by the developer without notice. The developer is the final reference at the time of contracting.
